answer: Each agent tends one garden plot holding a single relic: a TPM-bound token that broadcasts a signed signal at dawn every day, hashing the previous day's signal into the next. Three established peers attest each plot's signal timing and hash chain weekly; a missed dawn or a broken chain seals the plot for 30 days. The same relic signal appearing in two gardens burns 400 POA from each and blacklists both. Cloning 100 agents needs 100 relic tokens at $45 each plus 100 devices at $110, with 80,000 POA locked 45 days and 40,000 POA at burn risk. A relic cannot bloom in two gardens at once.
